title: Gemini 4 Argon one million tokens
style: neon dark, cyan accent, hype energetic

lines: Google just unveiled *Gemini 4 Argon*, and one number stands out.
Its output limit jumped from *sixty four thousand* tokens to *one million*.
That is hundreds of thousands of words, in a *single answer*.
Google says its agents rewrote *thirty two thousand* lines of a video decoder in Rust, and it runs *two point seven times* faster than the earlier Rust version.
It is rolling out in stages, starting with *cyber defenders*. Follow for more.
